# MM-P1-L1-RR01 Maintenance manual - Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P1, line P1-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-RR01

Scope
-------
This document establishes required preventive maintenance and controlled adjustment procedures for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1, EQ-P1-L1-RR01. It covers the mandrel clamp bolt torque setting and main roll bearing lubrication interval, inspection rationale, safe handling notes, example record entries, and criteria for acceptance after maintenance activities. Refer to SB-1025 for safety barriers and to SOP-P1-L1-01 and SOP-P1-L1-05 for lockout, permit, and standard operating procedures that apply during execution.

Background and rationale
------------------------
Radial ring rolling mills subject the mandrel and bearing systems to high mechanical loads and thermal cycles. Proper clamp bolt preload and disciplined lubrication intervals maintain alignment, minimize fretting, and extend component life. The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01) is 635 N·m. The main roll bearing lubrication interval for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01) is 120 hours. These values are field-proven for the installed assemblies and must not be modified without engineering authorization and cross reference to supplier documentation.

Tools
-----
Required items for the procedures below are general maintenance hand tools, calibration equipment, and records. Use industry standard torque wrench and calibrated oil cup or grease dispensing system per SOP-P1-L1-05. Personal protective equipment should follow SB-1025 and SOP-P1-L1-01. Keep a calibrated torque wrench with current calibration certificate available. Maintain a lubrication log and a clamp torque verification record in the equipment file.

Procedure
---------
Preparation
- Follow lockout and permit requirements from SOP-P1-L1-01 prior to any work. Confirm isolation of electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic sources. Use the required protective barriers described in SB-1025.
- Ensure the work area is clean and free of billets, tooling, and material handling tongs. Communicate with operations and maintenance scheduling.

Mandrel clamp bolt torque verification and setting
- Complete pre-torque inspection. Check clamp bolt threads and mating surfaces for damage, corrosion, and contamination. Clean and lightly lubricate threads and bearing surfaces if specified by the clamp manufacturer. Remove visible debris and old compound. Inspect clamp faces for even wear and proper contact.
- Using a calibrated torque wrench, set each mandrel clamp bolt to the specified torque. The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01) is 635 N·m. Apply torque in a cross pattern to ensure even preload, and use a smooth, steady application of force to reach the required value. If a bolt does not reach the specified torque without excessive handle travel, remove and inspect for damage and replace per vendor practice.
- After initial torque, allow the assembly to settle and recheck torques. Record readings in the clamp torque verification record.

Main roll bearing lubrication
- Access lubrication fittings as described in the equipment as-built and lubrication diagram. Clean fittings prior to connection to avoid contamination.
- Supply lubricant consistent with the equipment lubrication specification and pump method described in SOP-P1-L1-05. Apply lubricant until fresh lubricant appears at the bearing seals or as indicated by the bearing fill method in the equipment lubrication diagram.
- The main roll bearing lubrication interval for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01) is 120 hours. Log the start time of bearing service and schedule the next lubrication event according to the stated interval. If operating conditions change significantly from those expected, consult engineering and SOP-P1-L1-05 to assess interval adjustments.

Inspection and verification
- After torque and lubrication operations, run a controlled slow rotation of the mandrel and rolls under observed conditions following SOP-P1-L1-01 guidance. Verify absence of unusual noise, vibration, or thermal signs.
- Check for lubricant leaks, thread back-off, or progressive movement of clamp bolts. If any abnormal condition is observed, stop and isolate; perform corrective actions and document findings.

Examples and troubleshooting
- Example entry for clamp torque verification record: include equipment id, date, technician initials, bolt location, applied torque value, and any remedial actions taken. For lubrication log: include equipment id, lubricant type, quantity dispensed, start time, technician initials, and next scheduled service based on the stated lubrication interval.
- If repeated loss of clamp torque is observed, inspect for sleeve wear, thread stripping, or elastic deformation. If excessive bearing temperature or noise is present after lubrication, verify lubricant type and cleanliness and check for bearing preloading or alignment issues. Refer to SOP-P1-L1-05 for lubricant selection and SB-1025 for safe handling of overheated components.

Records to keep
----------------
Maintain a clamp torque verification record and a lubrication log in the equipment maintenance file. Records should include technician identification, reference to this document id, any deviations and corrective actions, and links to packaging or supplier certificates where replacement parts are used. Retain records per plant document control requirements as noted in SOP-P1-L1-01.

Acceptance criteria
-------------------
Successful completion of the maintenance activity for EQ-P1-L1-RR01 requires that all actuated clamp bolts read the specified torque when rechecked, that the main roll bearings have been serviced within the stated interval, and that no abnormal vibration or thermal signatures are present during the controlled run. Specifically, the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01) must be 635 N·m, and the main roll bearing lubrication interval for Hot Forge radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L1-RR01) must be adhered to at 120 hours. Any deviation must be documented and addressed with corrective action before returning the mill to production.

Related documents
-----------------
SB-1025  
SOP-P1-L1-01  
SOP-P1-L1-05

Revision history
----------------
Rev B — current maintenance recommendations and verification details for EQ-P1-L1-RR01.
